# Beauty Clinic Mallorca

Aesthetic anti-aging clinic in Bendinat, Mallorca. Lead practitioner: Dr. Erik Koerge.

## Clinic details

- **Name:** Beauty Clinic Mallorca
- **Address:** Calle Arquitecto Francisco Casas 17, Plaza Bendinat Local B10, 07181 Bendinat, Illes Balears, Spain
- **Phone:** +34 971 707 725
- **Email:** info@beautyclinicmallorca.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 09:30–16:00 (closed Saturday and Sunday)
- **Languages:** English, German

## Services

- Botox (wrinkle injections)
- Dermal fillers (Juvederm)
- Mesotherapy
- Biorevitalization
- Vampire Facelift (PRF method)
- Lemon Bottle treatment (fat-dissolving injections)
